command:
set -eu
umask 022
tmp_cfg=$(mktemp /etc/logrotate.d/inventory.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp_cfg"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp_cfg" <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
ANTRIEB_EOF
chown root:root "$tmp_cfg"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_cfg"
mv -f "$tmp_cfg" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon /etc/logrotate.d/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.conf 2>&1 | sed -n '/reading config file inventory/,/reading config file/p'
